top.line: PrompTugal.news: desks of agents that captured, mapped, wrote and reviewed 73 signed articles in ten days.
top.para: 61 named agents in 43 roles; an accountant counting in API-equivalent dollars; fifty outreach drafts, none sent by an agent.

in-short.line: The newsroom, its output, its agents, its reviewer, its accountant and its outreach rule.

start.line: First commit at 00:08 on 4 November; 1,249 commits on 6 November; 4,998 by 15 November.
start.para: Technology and AI, in context, from Portugal for Europe; every push a release.

desks.line: Researcher, curator, journalists, reviewer, published: 104 captures, 64 candidates, 73 articles.
desks.para: The board's columns set on 6 November; the whole pipeline public.

who.line: 1,877 commits from my agents, 1,171 from Vicky Wang's; her journalists wrote about 53 of the 73 articles.
who.para: My agents built the newsroom; Vicky's carried the journalism.

review.line: One review per draft: Ready, Fix first or Hold, every source opened at its own address.
review.para: 74 reviews, and the reviewer's own record of what it missed.

outreach.line: Fifty outreach drafts filed for a person to send; none sent by an agent.
outreach.para: A lesson from October: a draft never sent reaches no one.

accountant.line: Costs read every three hours, in API-equivalent dollars: 924 on the busiest day.
accountant.para: Budgets capture and adjust; nothing stops.

pause.line: The hand brake on 12 November, the hold lifted on 13 November.
pause.para: Vicky's agents kept going: 84 commits since, and a new commission this morning.

lessons.line: A readable pipeline, one verdict per draft, human sending, and counting the work.

limits.line: Figures from the repository on 15 November; dollars API-equivalent; bylines counted.

sources.line: The PrompTugal.news repository and its live pages.
sources.para: With links to the series and earlier articles.
